name: Ecommerce and retail
description: Marketplace, DTC, and retail catalog sites.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AOV
hasDefinedTerm.description: Total revenue divided by number of orders. Measures how much a typical customer spends per purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LTV
hasDefinedTerm.description: The total revenue expected from a customer across the whole relationship.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CAC
hasDefinedTerm.description: The total sales and marketing spend required to acquire one new customer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: conversion rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of visitors who complete a target action, usually a purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cart abandonment
hasDefinedTerm.description: When a shopper adds items then leaves without buying. Tracked as a percentage of carts created.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SKU
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unique identifier for one distinct sellable item, including its size and colour variant.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GTIN
hasDefinedTerm.description: A global trade item number identifying a product across retailers. Required for many shopping feeds.

hasDefinedTerm.name: product feed
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured file of catalog data submitted to shopping channels so they can list your items.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PDP
hasDefinedTerm.description: The page for a single product, carrying its description, images, price, and availability.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PLP
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page listing multiple products, usually filterable and paginated.

hasDefinedTerm.name: variant
hasDefinedTerm.description: A version of a product differing by one attribute such as size or colour. A frequent duplicate-content source.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Product schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data describing an item's price, availability, and reviews, enabling enriched shopping results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: out of stock
hasDefinedTerm.description: An unavailable item. How you handle the page matters: keeping and updating it usually beats removing it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: merchandising
hasDefinedTerm.description: Deciding which products surface where, in what order, to steer discovery and margin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: marketplace
hasDefinedTerm.description: A platform selling third-party inventory alongside or instead of its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: dropshipping
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selling goods fulfilled directly by a supplier, so the retailer never holds stock.

hasDefinedTerm.name: returns rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of orders sent back. A direct drag on contribution margin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: basket analysis
hasDefinedTerm.description: Studying which products are bought together to inform bundling and recommendations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: subscription commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selling on a recurring schedule rather than one purchase at a time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: BOPIS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Ordering online and collecting in a physical location.
alternateName: buy online pick up in store

ctx.expansion: Buy online, pick up in store

hasDefinedTerm.name: UCP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standardizes commerce capabilities so agents can discover products and complete purchases across platforms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agentic commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Purchases initiated and completed by an AI agent on a shopper's behalf.

hasDefinedTerm.name: price parity
hasDefinedTerm.description: Keeping a product's price consistent across the channels you sell on.

hasDefinedTerm.name: category taxonomy
hasDefinedTerm.description: The hierarchy products are organized into. Drives both navigation and crawl efficiency.

hasDefinedTerm.name: review schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data exposing ratings and reviews, commonly rendered as stars in results.
